children.name: Pattern/Drift
children.description: Theme-aware Drift pattern. Choose Density; inherit the containing frame’s Theme mode. Color variables: pattern/drift/*. Density 0, 1, 2, 3 correspond to 5, 10, 20, 40 slits. Scale uniformly or crop inside a frame. Never stretch. Keep type in calm areas and use one pattern structure per composition. Masks remain grayscale; edit the bound color layers for color.
